ranking_unit: first occurrence of a judged file within the first ten returned chunks; repeats consume rank
judgment_scope: Every fixture file is judged; omitted grades are zero. This small original corpus is a regression baseline, not general relevance qualification.

sources.Cargo.toml:
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
[package]
name = "fictional-refund-ledger"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"

[dependencies]
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
sources.docs/refunds.md:
# Refund authorization

A refund must remain below the daily limit. Retries use a refund idempotency key so the same payment is not refunded twice. The implementation is authorize_refund in src/refunds.rs.
sources.docs/recovery.md:
# Credential recovery

After a password reset, revoke all existing account sessions. Session revocation prevents an old credential from continuing to authorize requests. The implementation is revoke_session in src/sessions.rs.
sources.docs/retry.md:
# Transport retry policy

Retry only transient transport failures with bounded exponential backoff. The first delay is 25 milliseconds; subsequent delays double up to a maximum of 400 milliseconds. A permanent authorization failure must not be retried.
sources.docs/limits.md:
# Operational limits

| Operation | Daily limit | Retry policy |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Refund authorization | 50000 cents | Idempotency key required |
| Credential recovery | 3 attempts | Revoke existing sessions |
| Transport retry | 5 attempts | Exponential backoff, 400 ms cap |
sources.docs/packaging.md:
# Building the refund ledger

The fictional-refund-ledger Cargo package uses serde with the derive feature. Cargo.toml declares the package name, edition and dependency. This document concerns packaging, not refund authorization.
sources.docs/unrelated.md:
# Observatory maintenance

Polish the telescope mirror with a clean cloth. Schedule dome inspection after heavy snow.
